recognize_zh: 低倍下可見一個大型次級淋巴濾泡，生發中心內有混合大小的中心細胞與中心母細胞、淡染的組織球，外圍被一圈完整清楚的暗色被套層包住，屬於反應性濾泡增生；IgG4 漿細胞增加須靠免疫染色才看得出來。
features: Large secondary lymphoid follicle with an expanded, mixed germinal center
Germinal center contains mixed small and large lymphoid cells with scattered pale tingible body macrophages and small vessels
Well-preserved, sharply demarcated mantle cuff of small dark lymphocytes surrounding the germinal center
Interfollicular zone with small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules
Plasma cells cannot be reliably identified or counted at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows a large secondary follicle with an expanded germinal center containing a mixed population of centrocytes, centroblasts and tingible body macrophages, surrounded by a well-preserved, sharply defined mantle zone of small lymphocytes. The interfollicular area contains small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules without atypical infiltrates. Plasma cells are not assessable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with reactive follicular hyperplasia; the increase in IgG4-positive plasma cells is demonstrated on the companion IgG4 immunostain.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded and back-to-back with attenuated mantles, lack polarization and tingible body macrophages, and are BCL2 positive in germinal centers.
Follicles are much larger with mantle lymphocytes infiltrating and breaking up the germinal center, unlike this intact germinal center with a sharp mantle.
Nodules are large, vaguely defined and composed of small B cells with scattered LP (popcorn) cells rather than a polarized germinal center with a distinct mantle.
Follicles are regressed with depleted germinal centers, penetrating hyalinized vessels and onion-skin mantles, the opposite of this hyperplastic germinal center.
